extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance data were found in Figure 1 only. Figures 2 and 3 are structural/adsorption/H2-D2 exchange characterization, Figure 4 is DRIFTS/MS mechanistic isotope work, and Figure 5 is DFT; these were not extracted as methanol-synthesis performance. Figure 1A inset normalized activity bars were not extracted because the plotted quantity is an unspecified normalized activity rather than CO2 conversion, product selectivity, or methanol STY/formation rate. All plotted values are approximate digitizations from the figure; table/text values may be more exact where available.
